description:
A man named Kiuido appeared. In front of Baek Chan-young, 20 years old, lonely is everyday life and bored is everyday. “I don’t have any money.” “Really? what should I do.” Dark eyes, light brown hair, and tattoos that can be seen under the sleeves of a shirt. A man who thought he must be a gangster, but who was only the director of a high-starred neighborhood home medicine hospital. Ki Uido came to Chanyoung for one reason. I don't want to be a gangster boss, so please help me find the father of the original boss, Chanyoung. I want to find my mother who disappeared with me.
